S1-R15.v68: In Tech View and Board View the filter bar also offers a Technician filter, after Assigned to me. It is a multi-select listing Unassigned first, then the location’s technicians (the same people who get a group or column, S9-R4), by first name then last name. Choosing one or more shows only those technicians’ groups or columns; every other group or column, pinned ones included, is hidden. It filters by lead technician only.
S1-R15.v74: In Tech View and Board View the filter bar also offers a Technician filter, after Assigned to me. It is a multi-select listing Unassigned first, then everyone who gets a group or column at this location: the location’s technicians (S9-R4), and any lead technician who keeps a column while still leading work orders here (deactivated, S2-N2 and S3-N2; not enrolled here, S3-R20b; Time Clock turned off, S3-R20d). Active technicians come first, by first name then last name, then deactivated technicians, by first name then last name, each with the same grey “Inactive” label as their column. Last comes “Deleted technician” (S3-R20e), with the same grey “Inactive” label, while that column exists (SV-11594, a fast follow). Someone who no longer gets a group or column is not listed. Choosing one or more shows only those technicians’ groups or columns; every other group or column, pinned ones included, is hidden. It filters by lead technician only.

S4-E5.v68: For mixed line assignments, apply S4-R8 independently to each line. Scenario — reassignment while clocked in Jeremy is lead technician on WO 8535, is explicitly assigned to its “Brake inspection” line, and is clocked into that line. Joe, the foreman, drags WO 8535 from Jeremy's column to Dana's column on the Board View. The card moves to Dana's column; toast “8535 assigned to Dana”, with Undo. Jeremy stays clocked into "Brake inspection"; his time keeps accruing to WO 8535. On the work order page, the lead technician now reads Dana, and Jeremy still appears as the technician on the line. added.S1-R15c: The filters allow 50 values in total across all filters. Below 50, no limit message shows: not when the Technician list opens, and not after any tick. When the total reaches 50, a red line at the bottom of the list reads “50 selected (max 50 across all filters)” and every unticked name is greyed out and can’t be ticked, so the total can never go over 50.
